tasks.name: auto-cancel-stale-matches
tasks.description: Auto-cancel coinFlip matches that have been waiting more than 10 minutes with no opponent, triggering a buyIn refund to the creator.

tasks.name: distribute-fee-pool
tasks.description: Hourly fee-pool distribution. Snapshots all mnyStakes with amountStaked > 0 and writes one feePoolDistributions record per staker, atomically transferring their pro-rata share of SOL from the FEE_POOL_ID PDA to their wallet.

tasks.name: resolve-coinflip-matches
tasks.description: Resolve waiting coinFlip matches that have an opponent. Picks winner deterministically and triggers payout hook.
